THEBOOKOFAGES.mod_title: The Book of Ages GM Console
THEBOOKOFAGES-CHRONICLE_MOD_SECTION.titl: The Book of Ages Mod Settings
THEBOOKOFAGES-ENABLE_LOG.title: Enable GM console logs
THEBOOKOFAGES-ENABLE_LOG.hover.title: Only affects this mod
THEBOOKOFAGES-ENABLE_LOG.hover.desc: Controls logging for The Book of Ages GM Console only. It does not change BaseLib logs or any other mod logs.
THEBOOKOFAGES-ENABLE_CARD_PREHEAT.title: Enable card self-service preheat
Controls only the card self-service preheat behavior of The Book of Ages GM Console. It does not affect other mods.
THEBOOKOFAGES-PREVENT_DUPLICATE_RELIC_GR: Keeps the old behavior when enabled
When disabled, relic self-service can grant duplicate copies of the same relic. When enabled, already-owned relics are greyed out and skipped.
THEBOOKOFAGES-DIAGNOSTIC_SECTION.title: Diagnostic Export
THEBOOKOFAGES-ENABLE_DIAGNOSTIC_EXPORT.h: Enabled by default on PC, disabled on mobile

When a log at the configured level, a crash clue, multiplayer desync, or mod loading failure is detected, a diagnostic zip is created. PC builds enable this by default and prefer the desktop diagnostic folder. Mobile builds disable it by default; players can turn it on here, and reports are written under the game user data folder. The file stays on this device and is not uploaded automatically.
THEBOOKOFAGES-DIAGNOSTIC_EXPORT_MINIMUM_: Only logs at or above this level create diagnostic packages. Default is Error; choosing Warn allows both Warn and Error.
